The '''Starspeeder 1000''',<ref name="Insider225">{{InsiderCite|225|The Adventures Continue}}</ref> '''Star Tours Speeder''',<ref name="AFA" /> or '''StarSpeeder''', was a [[Realspace|space]]-capable [[commuter ship]]<ref name="Droidography" /> used by the [[Star Tours]] travel agency. Measuring 9.36 [[meter]]s in length, it was boxy with a downwardly angled front side, and featured at least five doors on starboard side.<ref name="AFA" /> It had four [[engine]]s that emanated a [[Color|blue]] glow.<ref name="Episode IX" />

In the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> a Star Tours Speeder was left parked at [[Niima Outpost]], on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Jakku]] on the day the [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] [[Escape from Jakku|fled]] the [[First Order]].<ref name="TFA">{{Film|VII}}</ref> The [[AC-series pilot droid]] [[AC-38]] once piloted one such [[starship]].<ref name="Droidography" /> In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' dates the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' as taking place one [[Standard year|year]] after the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|Starkiller Incident]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[34 ABY]]. Therefore, the events of ''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'' must take place in [[35 ABY]].</ref> after the [[Sith Eternal]] revealed itself to [[the galaxy]], at least one Star Tours Speeder joined the [[Citizens' Fleet|fleet]] assembled in response to [[General]] [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian's]] call to action and then partook in the [[Battle of Exegol]].<ref name="Episode IX" />

==Behind the scenes==
It was [[Jean-Denis Haas]], Associate Animation Supervisor at [[Industrial Light & Magic]], who put the Star Tours Speeder into the final space battle of the [[2019]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']]. While visible in the film, the Star Tours Speeder was originally supposed to be framed a bit more prominently.<ref name="Twit">{{Twitter|jeandenishaas|status/1226244041232093185|[[Jean-Denis Haas]]|quote=The Star Tours ship used to be framed a bit more prominently, but it's still in there.|archivedate=F20220409003937}}</ref> It originally appeared in [[2011]] in the non-canon ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'' attraction located at several [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney parks]] as the '''StarSpeeder 1000''', itself based on the [[StarSpeeder 3000]] from the original ''[[Star Tours]]'' that opened at [[Disneyland]] in [[1987]].<ref name="Star Tours">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>
